questions.text: Human activities that increase CO₂ include all these EXCEPT...
questions.explanation: Planting trees absorbs CO₂, not increases it.

questions.text: One effect of climate change is...
questions.explanation: Melting ice caps is an effect of climate change.

questions.text: Rising sea levels will affect coastal cities like...
questions.explanation: Lagos is a coastal city affected by rising sea levels.

questions.text: Mitigation strategies aim to ______ the release of greenhouse gases.
questions.explanation: Mitigation strategies aim to reduce greenhouse gases.

questions.text: Planting trees helps to ______ CO₂ from the atmosphere.
questions.explanation: Planting trees helps absorb CO₂.

questions.text: Adaptation strategies help us to ______ to climate changes.
questions.explanation: Adaptation strategies help us adjust to climate changes.

questions.text: Building sea walls to protect against rising sea levels is an ______ strategy.
questions.explanation: Building sea walls is an adaptation strategy.

questions.text: Desertification is a major problem in ______ Nigeria.
questions.explanation: Desertification is a major problem in Northern Nigeria.

questions.text: Which of the following is a cause of air pollution?
questions.explanation: Smoke from factory chimneys causes air pollution.

questions.text: Acid rain is caused by gases like...
questions.explanation: Acid rain is caused by sulphur dioxide.

A system of government where the citizens hold supreme power is called...
questions.explanation: This is democracy.

questions.text: 'Government of the people, by the people, and for the people' is a definition of...
questions.explanation: This is a definition of democracy.

questions.text: An organized group of people who share similar political beliefs and aim to win elections is a...
questions.explanation: This is a political party.

questions.text: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) is responsible for...
questions.explanation: INEC conducts and supervises elections.

questions.text: To vote in Nigeria, a citizen must be at least ______ years old and possess a PVC.
questions.explanation: The voting age in Nigeria is 18.

questions.text: PVC stands for...
questions.explanation: PVC stands for Permanent Voter's Card.

questions.text: The process where political parties and candidates try to persuade voters is called...
questions.explanation: This is campaigning.

questions.text: After voting closes, the next step in the voting process is the public...
questions.explanation: The next step is the counting of votes.

questions.text: The main aim of a political party is to...
questions.explanation: The main aim is to win elections and control government.

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of a political party in Nigeria?
questions.explanation: APC is a political party in Nigeria.

questions.text: The total number of people living in a specific geographical area at a particular time is called...
questions.explanation: This is population.

questions.text: The official and systematic counting of the entire population of a country is known as...
questions.explanation: This is a census.

questions.text: A situation where the population of a country is too large for the available resources to support is called...
questions.explanation: This is overpopulation.

questions.text: Which of the following is a major cause of population growth?
questions.explanation: High birth rate is a major cause of population growth.

questions.text: The movement of people into a country is known as...
questions.explanation: This is immigration.

questions.text: A low death rate contributes to population growth because...
questions.explanation: A low death rate means fewer people are dying.

questions.text: Which of the following is an effect of overpopulation on social services?
questions.explanation: Overpopulation leads to overcrowded schools.

questions.text: Census data is important for...
questions.explanation: Census data is important for planning social services.

questions.text: 'Natality' refers to the...
questions.explanation: Natality refers to the birth rate.

questions.text: When the population grows faster than the economy, it often leads to...
questions.explanation: It leads to high unemployment.
